question: Does dream-heard instruction bear fruit through identity-contemplation?
premises: hearing in dream-time reaches the thing there too
inference: Dream-hearing does not ripen into fruitful identity-union.
uncertainties: negative scope (na phalaya na bhanyate) read as declared-fruitless
plain_english: Therefore at dream-time, what is heard — even of that thing — identity-contemplation union is not for fruit, it is declared.
